Chapter 708: Chapter 12 Dimensionality Reduction (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 708: Chapter 12 Dimensionality Reduction (Subscribe Please)_2

Nalan sighed.

As an Eleventh-Rank Evolver, each one of them was crucial, even on a Large Alien Battlefield, where an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse was a suppressing force.

As for a Supreme Being?

Unless they were truly provoked to wrath and other factors emerged, a Supreme Being would not enter the fray.

Below the Supreme Beings, Eleventh Rank was the strongest. Even for an Evolver like Nalan who had just entered the Eleventh Rank, they could influence the outcome of widespread regional wars.

“I’ve heard about this too,” Lin Yuan nodded.

...

In fact, Battlefield A098 was the very Large Alien Battlefield where his Taiyang Divine Spirit resided.

Some time ago, Lin Yuan had faintly sensed a change in the situation at the Large Alien Battlefield and realized that a more intense war might be imminent.

…

“As long as the intensity of the war doesn’t reach the level where a Supreme Being needs to step in, it shouldn’t affect me much.”

On Battlefield A098, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged beneath an Eternal Spatial Rift, using his understanding of space and time to hide, making it difficult for other Tenth and Eleventh Rank powerhouses to discover him.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s figure sat in the deeper Spatial Layers.

Awe-inspiring vital energy circulated, and within a hundred miles around him, a profound yellow-colored force field faintly spread.

One of the three great defensive Secret Techniques of the Profound Yellow Lineage, the “Xuanhuang Physique.”

No matter the heritage, the most crucial aspect was surely survival; only by living could there be hope.

This was the case with the Profound Yellow Lineage, where survival was ensured with the “Xuanhuang Physique” and “Spatial Temporal Steps.”

“The Third Layer…” Lin Yuan opened his eyes and sighed softly.

The “Xuanhuang Physique” is divided into four layers, with the Fourth Layer being the Ultimate Realm.

A Twelfth-Rank Life with a Perfected “Xuanhuang Physique” was said to be unbreakable and immortal, easily able to withstand the devastations at the end of a Cosmic Epoch.

However.

As he continued to practice.

Lin Yuan became increasingly aware of the difficulty of this Secret Technique.

The resources needed for cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique” were indeed vast.

Initially, Lin Yuan thought that with the abundant Xuanhuang Crystals inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, along with the corpses and treasures of nearly ten thousand Ninth-Rank Alien Races,

he could cultivate this technique to a deeper level.

This was also what Lin Yuan deduced from the many pieces of information about this Secret Technique.

But the result was that Lin Yuan had overlooked a crucial factor.

That being, he was not like a normal Tenth Rank Life.

If it were an ordinary Tenth Rank Life, with the vast resources of the Secret Realm, their cultivation needs could naturally be met.

But Lin Yuan?

Before transcending to the Tenth Rank, his physical body was already hundreds of times stronger than others of his Tier.

After entering the Tenth Tier, having been infused with the Chaos Void Origin, the disparity had reached a scale magnified by tens of thousands.

And this was just the physical body.

There were also the worlds inside his Soul Bodies.

A normal powerhouse needs one set of resources to elevate their “Xuanhuang Physique” to the next layer.

Lin Yuan needed hundreds of thousands, if not millions, of sets of resources.

Though ultimately satisfied with his enhancements, the resources required were indeed numerous.

And this was just Lin Yuan’s original true body; his two Primordial Spirits were still on the sidelines.

Since stepping into the Tenth Rank and discovering a surge in his resource needs, Lin Yuan had decisively halted his two Primordial Spirits from cultivating the “Xuanhuang Physique” Secret Technique.

This kind of defensive Secret Technique should definitely be prioritized by the original body; as for the two Primordial Spirits, they had to be slightly wronged for the time being.

…

On Battlefield A098.

Lin Yuan still sat beneath the Eternal Spatial Rift, cultivating.

“In recent months, at least a hundred more Eleventh Rank powerhouses have appeared on the battlefield,” Lin Yuan glanced at the distant region in between his cultivation sessions.

The total visible Eleventh-Rank Evolvers of the entire Human Civilization also didn’t exceed a thousand.

Now, just on one battlefield, there were over a hundred Eleventh Rank, and that didn’t include those Eleventh Rank powerhouses who were originally stationed there.

And those who secretly came over, evading Lin Yuan’s perception.

“Tuoba Ancient God…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes were deep, having heard about Tuoba Ancient God on this battlefield.

Tuoba Ancient God was invited by the Insect Race to bolster their forces.

Tuoba Ancient God was also the Ancient God corresponding to the Evolution Path initially cultivated by Fang Qing.

Because of an issue involving Fang Qing, Lin Yuan had a quite a grievance with this Ancient God.

Since Lin Yuan became an Evolver, Tuoba Ancient God was the first lifeform bold enough to openly extort him.

…

According to the information Lin Yuan obtained about Tuoba Ancient God,

this Ancient God was a powerful Eleventh-Rank Life of the fifth-tier, ranking among the top Ancient Gods, audacious enough to disregard Sizhong Ancient God and even aiming to reach the Ultimate within a million years.

Sizhong Ancient God once stated that Tuoba Ancient God only had a lifespan of a hundred million years.

But an Eleventh-Rank Life’s hundred million years lifespan isn’t measured by the flow of time in the Main World.

With Tuoba Ancient God’s manipulation of the flow of time, by the time of the Main World’s hundred billion years, he might still be alive.

However, the fact that Tuoba Ancient God had the ambition to strive for the Ultimate indicated that he might not continue to delay his time and barely cling to life.

Indeed, many ancient special beings born at the creation of the universe had already lived long enough. Slowing down their own time flow rate to achieve an alternative form of immortality held little significance.

Even if they survived era after era, could that make them achieve the Ultimate?

Yet, every Eleventh-Rank Life’s viewpoint differed.

Some Eleventh-Rank Lives believed that in the distant future, there lay the hope of becoming the Ultimate, while others thought that since they must die sooner or later, they might as well strive for the Ultimate as soon as possible.

Of course, those with the latter belief tend to be solitary and special beings.
